verdict.rationale: No evidence describes controls for retaining or deleting data (e.g., telemetry, Terraform Cloud run data, or data passed through the MCP server) — the pack only covers infrastructure resource lifecycle (plan/apply/destroy) and state management, not privacy-oriented data retention/deletion controls. missing for 10: any documentation of data retention policy, user-facing deletion/export controls, or MCP server data handling/retention settings.
